name: The Agency: Chapter 1
source:
In a fictional dystopic sci-fi steampunk world still recovering from the destruction of a recent global war, a young man travels to the imperial capital city to seek better fortunes for himself. Upon his arrival, he is recruited in a private investigators agency and is soon embroiled in a case that will change his life forever!

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/492280]Steam[/url]]
